problem: OpenCode was snapshotting the full D:\codex worktree into a Git-backed state store, causing snapshot/global object growth into tens of gigabytes.
root_cause: OpenCode workspace root was the entire D:\codex tree
Local state root was shared with a large Git-backed snapshot store
Generated artifacts, caches, and auxiliary worktrees were not separated from interaction state
fix: Move OpenCode to a dedicated small workspace: D:\codex\opencode-workspace
Move fast OpenCode to a dedicated small workspace: D:\codex\opencode-workspace-fast
Move OpenCode local state to dedicated roots: D:\codex\oi-state-opencode and D:\codex\oi-state-opencode-fast
Delete the old OpenCode snapshot subtrees under D:\codex\oi-state\xdg\opencode and D:\codex\oi-state-fast\xdg\opencode
Keep core state in MetaForge memory, identity, dialogue, and checkpoint registries
guardrails: OpenCode local state is disposable and should remain small
Core state changes must go through controller-backed workflows
Do not point OpenCode at the full D:\codex tree again
Treat large generated folders as non-core and keep them out of the interaction workspace
validation: OpenCode help launches from the new workspace layout
New state roots contain only small startup cache/log directories
